privacyUseLi1: Create and manage your game account

privacyStorageP1: Your data is stored securely in encrypted databases. We use industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, hashed passwords, and secure session management via JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
privacyDeletionP1: In-game accounts may be removed automatically based on game mechanics (player inactivity). You may also request full deletion of your data by contacting us.

privacyChangesP1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacyContactP1: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to request data deletion, please reach out through the in-game chat or contact us via our GitHub repository.

termsDescP1: n38worth is a social strategy game where players hire, sell, and trade virtual player stocks. All in-game credits and values are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.
termsAccountP1: You may create an account using a username and password or by signing in with Facebook. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. Each person may only operate one account.
termsMechanicsP1: The game includes mechanics such as player value changes and automatic account deletion for inactive players. These mechanics are part of the game design and may change at any time.
